title: Paper-based Devices for Isolation and Characterization of Extracellular Vesicles
protocol: Cut chromatography paper into circles of 5 mm in diameter.
Sandwich the cut paper pieces with two polystyrene sheets that have registered through-holes.
Laminate the assembled paper devices.
Treat paper devices with oxygen plasma (100 mW, 1% oxygen, 30 sec) in a plasma chamber.
Incubate treated paper devices in a 4% (v/v) solution of 3-mercaptopropyl trimethoxysilane in ethanol for 30 min.
Rinse paper devices with ethanol.
Incubate paper devices with 0.01 μmol/ml GMBS in ethanol for 15 min.
Rinse paper devices with ethanol (200 proof).
Incubate paper devices with 10 µg/ml avidin solution in phosphate buffered saline (PBS) for 1 hr at 4 °C.
Store paper devices at 4 °C if needed, and use within 4 weeks.
Wet each paper test zone with 10 μl PBS containing 1% (w/v) bovine serum albumin (BSA) for 3 × 10 min.
Spot 10 μl biotinylated capture molecules on the wet zones for 3 × 10 min.
Rinse off unbound anti-CD63 antibody or annexin V molecules using 10 μl corresponding PBS containing 1% (w/v) BSA or annexin V binding buffer solutions for 3 × 1 min, respectively.
Collect 10 ml of peripheral blood by venipuncture in serum separation tubes and gently invert the tube five times.
Set the tube vertically and wait for 30 min.
Centrifuge at 1,200 × g for 15 min.
Transfer the serum from the top layer to a clean tube.
Centrifuge again at 3,000 × g for 30 min.
Pass the supernatant through a 0.8 μm filter.
Keep the sample at -80 °C until use.
Collect aqueous humor samples from patients diagnosed by an ophthalmologist directly through invasive procedures.
Store aqueous humor samples at -80 °C until use.
Spot samples onto each paper test zone at a rate of 5 μl/min.
Rinse unbound EVs with 10 μl PBS containing 1% BSA for 3 × 1 min on anti-CD63 antibody-functionalized zones.
Rinse unbound EVs with 10 μl annexin V binding buffer for 3 × 1 min on annexin V-functionalized zones.
Fix EVs using 10 μl of 0.5× Karnovsky’s fixative for 10 min.
Rinse samples with PBS for 2 × 5 min.
Dehydrate samples with 35% ethanol for 10 min, followed by 50% ethanol for 2 × 10 min.
Continue dehydration with 70% ethanol for 2 × 10 min, then 95% ethanol for 2 × 10 min.
Final dehydration step with 100% ethanol for 4 × 10 min.
Dry and sputter coat samples with palladium/gold.
Examine samples using a scanning electron microscope at low voltage (~5 kV).
Add 5 μl of anti-CD9 primary antibody (1:1,000 dilution) in PBS to each test zone containing captured EVs.
Wait for 1 min after adding the primary antibody.
Rinse samples with 30 ml PBS shaken at 100 rpm for 30 sec.
Add 5 μl of HRP-linked secondary antibody (1:1,000 dilution) in PBS and wait 1 min.
Rinse samples again with 30 ml PBS shaken at 100 rpm for 30 sec.
Add a 5 μl colorimetric substrate containing hydrogen peroxide and TMB (1:1 ratio).
Scan the test zones using a desktop scanner.
Immerse samples in 35 μl of polyvinylpyrrolidone-based RNA isolation aid and 265 μl of lysis/binding buffer.
Vortex vigorously.
Add 30 μl homogenate provided in the isolation kit to the lysate.
Vortex vigorously.
Put on ice for 10 min.
Take 330 μl of phenol-chloroform from the bottom layer and add to the homogenate/lysate.
Vortex vigorously.
Centrifuge at 10,000 x g for 5 min.
Transfer the aqueous (upper) phase to a clean tube.
Note the volume removed.
Precipitate total RNA with 1.25 times the volume of the aqueous phase in 100% ethanol.
Collect the RNA in the elution solution preheated to 95 °C.
Concentrate and further purify the RNA using an RNA cleanup kit according to the manufacturer’s protocol.
